title: Expanded and Recycled Recipes
description: Expanded and Recycled Recipes adds horse armor crafting recipes and allows you to recycle armor and tools to recover materials.
body:
Expanded and Recycler Recipes is a Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that enhances your crafting and recycling options in your world. This mod adds crafting recipes for horse armor, allowing you to create them directly at the crafting table instead of relying on loot or trading.

It also introduces a recycling system that lets you recover materials from armor, weapons, pickaxes, axes, and hoes. Instead of letting old gear go to waste or take up storage space, you can now reclaim part of the resources and make better use of them.

Perfect for players looking for a more balanced, practical, and sustainable gameplay experience without changing the core feel of the game.
